build_moses_tokenizer: build a MosesTokenizer with MosesTokenizerConfig to tokenize text for a given source language
encode_text_with_moses: encode a string using MosesTokenizer.encode to tokenize text with configurable dash splits and escaping
decode_text_with_moses: decode a tokenized string using MosesTokenizer.decode to detokenize text for a given target language
review_moses_tokenizer_config: review the MosesTokenizerConfig dataclass to customize source language, target language, dash splits, and escape options
test_moses_tokenizer_encode_decode: test the MosesTokenizer encode and decode round-trip to verify tokenization and detokenization work correctly
